strings.Gui.ExcludeHint:
・ Exclude images in added folders if the filename ends with `-Trimmed-number`.
・ For example, `image-Trimmed-1.png` is excluded.
・ Images are identified by filename, not processing history. Files added individually are not excluded.
・ Changing this setting updates pending images in the list.
strings.Gui.RecursiveHint:
・ Also search subfolders of the folders you add.
・ Changing this setting updates pending images in the list.
strings.Gui.RemoveHint:
・ Remove the selected images from the list.
・ Original and saved image files are not deleted.
strings.Gui.ClearHint:
・ Remove all images from the list.
・ Original and saved image files are not deleted.
